## Smoother editing and visible grid counts
- **Keep the counts in view.** The counting strip stays visible while scrolling down through the instrument rows, and beat numbers, subdivisions and stickings stay aligned when scrolling sideways. Works in the main grid and Chart Builder's beat editor. - **Lighter scrolling and editing.** The grid reuses more of its drawing work, and editing notes avoids rebuilding unrelated transport controls. - **Smoother playhead.** The cursor glides across barlines. Play Only Bar keeps the cursor inside the chosen bar, and Pupil View stays within the selected playback range. - **Safer Reverse Bar.** Ghost notes entered on 32nd and triplet grids are preserved. If a reversal would lose notes, stickings or part of a sustain, BeatBake leaves the groove intact and explains why.
BeatBake 1.0 (169). Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later.
